claim: Discipline is how we create the life we want, including the inner world: joy, peace and focus
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Discipline applies to everything, not just workouts or food: every physical choice, which thoughts we engage with, and how we work through our emotions
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Porn is present right now for a lot of men
For other men, porn is further away, with a little worry it may come back, or it feels well behind them
Whether porn is present now or further away, the pause-intention bridge applies to everyone
name: Discipline and intention

claim: In porn we act from compulsion, not intention
Much of daily life also runs on compulsion, even when it's just habit and may not even be bad or negative
name: Discipline and intention

claim: We are not actually living by intention very often, or for very many minutes of the day
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The more moments lived from intention, the better life gets
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Once you truly want porn out of your life, the difference between wanting that and having it is discipline
Discipline comes from intention
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Reaction is close to compulsion
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Compulsion probably fits porn or video games that suck your life away better than reaction does
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Reaction fits relationships and conversations: responding at once and often emotionally, through trauma and filters, creates bad communication and often repeats the same negative patterns
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The difference between keeping porn and quitting it, between communication that works and doesn't, and between creating what you want and not, is intention
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The pause-intention bridge: picture walking the same trail every day, with a big hole in it. Beside the hole is a narrow ledge, maybe with a little rope to hold on to. Notice the hole coming, step onto the ledge on purpose, and you get across with little effort
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Getting across the hole on the trail only takes awareness of the hole and of the way across
name: Discipline and intention

claim: In the pause-intention bridge, the first step is at least lifting your head
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Sometimes, looking down at your feet and pulled along, you fall in the hole on the trail all of a sudden
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The hole on the trail can stay. The urge for porn, any other compulsion, or the pull to be lazy is okay and doesn't need to go away
name: Discipline and intention

claim: You only need to pause long enough to move with intention
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The pause-intention bridge is not a one-time fix but a tool you will use every single day
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Suggested practice: pause before any action, even for a fraction of a second or a few seconds. No 10-minute meditation needed
name: Discipline and intention

claim: In the pause before any action, ask: does this align with my intention, with my truth?
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Pausing before any action and asking whether it aligns with your intention, over and over, is "the secret, if there is one" to quitting porn and to building "absolute discipline"
name: Discipline and intention

claim: "No action" is still an action. Scrolling your phone or playing video games is an action
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Even meditation is an action: choosing to sit down is an action, and moment to moment the action is listening to your inner world with curiosity
name: Discipline and intention

claim: We are always taking action
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Behind the habits you want to get rid of, there is probably no pause and no intention, just getting pulled along
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The very simple but very powerful act of being willing to pause for a moment and then actually choose an action is critical to getting rid of habits
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Don't expect perfection: you won't pause 100% of the time, or even close ("never gonna happen"), and even if you did, you wouldn't always act on intention
name: Discipline and intention

claim: In coaching, many men working on porn reach a stage where they may pause, sometimes for a long time, see what is happening, and still take the action
Pausing and still taking the action is part of the process: the pause also lets you see the action with more awareness, and you can't change what you aren't aware of
name: Discipline and intention

claim: You don't need to pause 100% of the time, or even 80%. Just work on it
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The episode on the pause-intention bridge was recorded on a hike, with pauses before arriving, before choosing a direction and in the car before starting to walk
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Pause at critical moments and as often as you can to check: am I acting on intention, and what is my intention?
name: Discipline and intention

claim: In conversations, pause before you react or speak
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Text conversations give even more room to pause before you react, but it works in person and on the phone too
name: Discipline and intention

claim: The briefest pause can make all the difference in communicating calmly, connected, not reactive, aligned with your truth instead of the anger or the other stories
name: Discipline and intention

claim: Pause, intention: the bridge from a compulsive, lower-frequency life to a higher-frequency life of intention, discipline and success, whatever that looks like to you, in every layer of life
name: Discipline and intention
